headline: Bank Maybank (BNII) Officially Holds 51% of Maybank Sekuritas, Acquisition Worth Rp 583 Billion
summary: Bank Maybank Indonesia has officially taken control of 51% of Maybank Sekuritas after acquiring the stake for Rp 583.74 billion. The deal is meant to strengthen its financial conglomerate.
why: Bank Maybank Indonesia is the Indonesian banking unit of Malaysia-based Maybank, and it is listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Securities brokerage acquisitions expand a bank group's capital markets business.
